Definition: BibTeX identifier after @ARTICLE{, separate from study_id. Each entry represents a synthesis in Dataset 2. Missing or empty fields mean no metadata are available.
Institutional affiliations and countries, separated by semicolons.
Author names, separated by the BibTeX word and.
Keywords in the exported author-keyword field.
Scopus citation count at the time of export (Cited by: n).
Page range; can be empty for article-number publications.
